dsh-vision-solution 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。为 DSH 纯文本模型补充视觉能力：识图技能（图片理解/OCR/文档解析，竞速池→自定义通道→本地）+ 幂等宿主补丁，让图片消息能送达模型侧。

posts.en:
dsh-vision-solution is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Give DSH text-only models vision: an image/OCR/document recognition skill (race pool → custom channels → local) plus an idempotent host patch so image messages reach the model.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-1988c3c99e997cad00f4.html
